# defectdojo_location_product (Data Source)

Data source for DefectDojo Location Product. Links a Location (e.g. a URL or Network Location) to a Product. Looked up by id only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_location_product" "example" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier

### Read-Only

- `location` (Number) The ID of the Location.
- `location_type` (String) The type of the linked Location.
- `location_value` (String) The value representation of the linked Location.
- `product` (Number) The ID of the Product.
- `relationship` (String) The relationship between the location and the product. Valid values: 'owned_by', 'used_by'.
- `status` (String) The status of the given Location. Valid values: 'Active', 'Mitigated'.
